newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary's forint ends firmer against the dollar.
newsitem.headline: Hungary's forint ends firmer against the dollar.

text.p: Hungary's forint closed afternoon trade a shade firmer against the dollar on Tuesday, after tracking the movements of the dollar/mark cross all day, dealers said.
The forint closed at 181.15/20 to the dollar, compared with 181.22/25 at midday and 181.10/15 at the opening.
"We followed the dollar/mark at the NBH bid (central bank resistance level)," said Unicbank's Gabor Liener.
The forint floats within the National Bank of Hungary's 4.5 percent wide intervention range, against a currency basket made up 30 percent of the dollar and 70 percent of the mark.
